name: What information do you need before framing a new door opening?
description: You need the wall type, door size, wall thickness, and whether the opening is load-bearing before framing starts.

mainEntity.name: What information do you need before framing a new door opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most important factor is whether the wall is load-bearing, because that changes the amount of support the opening needs and how the header is built. The door size, wall thickness, and whether you are installing a prehung interior or exterior unit also affect the framing layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need the wall type, door size, wall thickness, and whether the opening is load-bearing before framing starts.
